[1/3] Track consecutive daily-run participation and show the streak in both dossiers

impact_assessment.why: Daily runs record a best gain per day but no streak, so returning players have no visible retention signal or long-term daily goal.
impact_assessment.benefits: A streak makes the daily challenge a habit loop, distinguishes same-day repeats from consecutive days, and adds a durable career stat without changing gameplay balance.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: career.json gains additive streak fields; dependency: none; concurrency: settlement remains one-shot; state: old careers default to zero and same-day repeats must not inflate the streak.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Resolve consecutive days by ISO date, treat same-day repeats as no-ops, reset on gaps, sanitize old values, and cover first/consecutive/same-day/gap paths in engine and CLI tests.

[1/3] Add a one-use Dead Man Switch shop item that banks half the unbanked loot on lockout

impact_assessment.why: Lockout currently wipes all unbanked loot with no mid-run mitigation; the push-your-luck loop has no costly insurance decision.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can trade banked credits for a partial safety net, creating a real risk-pricing choice and a new use for the Black Market.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CyberDeck and shop catalog gain an additive field/item; dependency: none; concurrency: settlement remains one-shot; state: old saves default uninsured, and the consumable must not persist as a career upgrade.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default the deck flag to false, consume it only on a lockout payout, exclude consumables from career persistence, and cover purchase, lockout, persistence and old-save behavior with tests.

[1/4] Add a seeded rival netrunner who steals posted contracts and can be countered

impact_assessment.why: The living grid pressures the player through alert and hunters, but no other netrunner competes for the Syndicate job board, so the world has no peer antagonist.
impact_assessment.benefits: A named rival creates urgency around offers, gives the job board a social competitor, and adds a new CPU-spending counterplay decision.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState gains a persisted rival object and a new action/command; dependency: none; concurrency: one rival acts inside the turn loop; state: old saves must fabricate a rival cleanly and counterplay must not double-delay.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Generate the rival deterministically from the run seed, persist it through save/load, schedule actions on absolute turns, cap counter delays, and cover steal, empty-board, counter, old-save and API paths with tests.

[4/4] Rival netrunner complete; project gate 5/5, 396 tests; checklists: passed

[1/4] Score each settled run and keep a top-10 career Hall of Fame

impact_assessment.why: Run history and milestones record outcomes but provide no single comparable performance number or all-time ranking.
impact_assessment.benefits: A transparent score turns each run into a measurable result, gives the dossier a leaderboard, and makes replaying seeds or dailies more meaningful.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: career.json gains additive hall_of_fame data and run summaries gain score fields; dependency: none; concurrency: settlement remains one-shot; state: old careers default empty and duplicate settlement must not duplicate hall entries.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the formula in one scoring module, insert/dedupe/cap inside the one-shot settlement path, sanitize old payloads, and cover weights, rank, cap, persistence and both displays with tests.

[3/4] Difficulty engine, CLI/API and Web selector green; 409 tests
[1/4] Add three difficulty modes with trace, starting-condition and contract-pay modifiers

impact_assessment.why: Every run used the same trace curve and contract economy, so experienced players had no explicit challenge dial and newer players had no gentler entry point.
impact_assessment.benefits: Easy and Hard create replayable challenge levels, persist in the archive and leaderboard, and isolate balance changes in one module.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine/save/history payloads gain a difficulty field and the API reset accepts one; dependency: none; concurrency: one run per session; state: normal must remain byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged and old saves must default to normal.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize unknown values to normal, keep Normal multipliers at 1.0, apply modifiers in central trace/payout methods, persist the field, and cover both non-normal and default paths with tests.
